Definition: from the same as G5443; a sprout, i.e. leaf:--leaf.
BiblicalUsage: Phyllon is a leaf. Jesus says to learn the parable of the fig tree: when its branch is tender and puts forth leaves, summer is near, in Matthew 24:32. And the leaves of the tree of life in Revelation 22:2 are for the healing of the nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a leaf can preach — it tells the season, and in the end it heals the nations.
